title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Information Technology Manager at LEDN

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Selection Process

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: pharmacovigilance associate
description:
Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leading the collection, evaluation, and processing of adverse event reports to ensure timely and accurate reporting in accordance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.
  • Conducting thorough data analysis and interpretation of safety data, identifying trends and potential safety signals that require further investigation.
  • Preparing and submitting comprehensive periodic safety update reports (PSURs) and other regulatory documents, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.

title: Remote Senior Accountant

About the Company

Awarded Inc. Magazine's Best Workplaces for the fourth year in a row! AccountingDepartment.com is the leader in outsourced virtual accounting services for businesses and our family is growing! Perhaps your next career adventure awaits! AccountingDepartment.com never settles with status quo. We strive to make sure our staff have plenty of opportunities that broaden skill sets and ultimately enhance career satisfaction while working here. If you're someone who wants to make a difference, is a confident communicator, loves a good challenge, and happily embraces change, then we sound like a perfect match! It has been an exciting 21 years at AccountingDepartment.com! We hope you will join us as we continue this exciting revolutionary journey we are on.

Your Role

The Senior Accountant role is designed for an experienced professional who is ready for the next step in their accounting career. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated, meticulous and enthusiastic with a can‑do attitude. This position is responsible for handling complex accrual‑based accounting tasks for multiple clients, requiring minimal direction from Controllers. The Senior Accountant must possess strong analytical skills, excellent technical knowledge, and the ability to deliver accurate and timely results. A person in this role is comfortable using relevant knowledge, know‑how and skills to convey clear and concise thoughts and ideas to clients and internal teams, both in written format and during virtual meetings. Adaptability is key to thriving in this fast‑paced environment, as the role demands responsiveness to changing expectations and processes to provide exceptional value to clients.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain books for multiple clients on an accrual basis, often with the help of an Assistant or Accountant as needed
  • Completion of timely and accurate monthly close process and financial reporting, including class reporting, job‑costing, analysis of account categories and defining trends
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts receivable process, including unbilled revenue, deferred income, and bad debt allowances
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts payable process, including vendor bills, and online payments
  • Prepare cash management flash report
  • Responsible for properly tracking inventory and identifying unusual or unexpected results
  • Responsible for fixed asset and intangible asset management, including maintaining depreciation and amortization schedules and posting related journal entries for acquisitions and disposals
  • Payroll processing using Intuit or other third‑party payroll applications and review quarterly and annual reports such as: W‑2, W‑3, 941, and state U/E. Ability to identify and resolve payroll issues
  • Support management with gathering documentation for budgets, forecasts and annual audit
  • Record and maintain financing transactions, such as loans and investments, including proper classification of short‑term and long‑term commitments
  • Evaluate lease contracts to determine short‑term/long‑term classification
  • Calculate and prepare tax forms and payments, such as sales & use tax, property tax returns, and client‑specific business tax and franchise tax filings
  • Assist with review and preparation of 1099s and year‑end payroll inclusions
  • Updating and maintaining data for established KPIs
  • Responsible for updating various dashboards and reports and budgets in Jirav
  • Take full ownership of writing and updating the Client Procedure Manual to ensure it is complete and accurate at all times
  • Use critical thinking to research issues and provide meaningful solutions
  • Independently interpret, research, and apply knowledge to resolve technical accounting issues
  • Embraces various technologies and applications to make process improvement recommendations
  • Be a proactive change‑agent; take the lead in identifying cumbersome processes and explore options of applying new technology to increase job efficiency and effectiveness
  • Lead client meetings and provide a high‑level of customer service
  • Partner with client third‑party advisors for exchange of data and reports
  • Tracks time on client engagements and manages work to meet deadlines within established time budgets; able to explain budget variances
  • Assists on special projects and additional responsibilities as needed
  • Pursues opportunities for continuous learning

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years performing full‑charge bookkeeping and 2+ years using QuickBooks and/or NetSuite Software, including daily transaction processing, monthly close and financial reporting
  • Advanced knowledge of fundamental bookkeeping and accounting principles, practices and procedures, including enhanced levels of: financial reporting and analysis, budgeting, prepaids/accruals, capitalization, financing, job costing and regulatory tax requirements
  • Possess a very high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Self‑directed, highly motivated and proactive
  • Highly organized and process‑driven
  • Excellent problem‑solving, critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Proven experience meeting deadlines
  • Comfortable delegating tasks and providing feedback
  • Friendly, outgoing personality with a positive attitude and strong customer service skills who enjoys meeting and interacting with clients and staff
  • Displays excellent communication, collaboration, and problem‑solving skills
  • Comfortable interacting with clients via phone and webcam
  • Demonstrate ability to succeed in a fast‑paced environment
  • Innovative thinker and embraces change
  • Able to work independently and as a team player
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word and Outlook

Minimum Education & Training Required

  • Proficient with accounting software, including but not limited to QuickBooks Desktop, QuickBooks Online, NetSuite and Sage Intacct
  • Experience with third‑party applications is preferred, such as Bill.com, Tallie, Jirav, and TeamWork
  • Ongoing desire to expand knowledge of new technology and applications
  • AIPB, a 2‑year associate’s degree in an accounting‑related field of study, or Minor in Accounting, preferred but not required

Cultural Fit

  • Grit: Motivated self‑starter with a positive, can‑do attitude. Demonstrates GRIT in overcoming obstacles and accomplishing tasks.
  • Gratitude: Expresses appreciation for the contributions of team members, fostering a positive and collaborative work environment.
  • Resilience: Demonstrates flexibility and determination while autonomously managing high‑priority tasks and projects in an ever‑evolving, dynamic work environment.
  • Integrity: Unquestionable commitment to upholding the highest standards of ethical behavior and transparency in all business practices.
  • Teamwork: Proven ability to contribute effectively to organizational and team objectives through strong teamwork skills.

Working at AccountingDepartment.com, LLC

The people at AccountingDepartment.com, LLC are passionate about their work and are driven by innovation. Each and every day we strive for excellence. Our work environment is equal parts casual and professional. We’re serious about our business and delivering the best service to our clients, but we also make it a priority to keep things fun and exciting.

Benefits Include

  • Work from home, W‑2 position
  • Three work schedule options including Full Time (37‑40 hours), Mod Time (33‑36 hours) or Part Time (30‑32 hours). Minimum working hours must be M‑F 9am‑3pm in your time zone, with flexibility to accommodate client calls and meetings outside of those hours as needed
  • Compressed work week option available
  • Generous vacation and paid holidays
  • Group Medical, Dental, Life, Vision, Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Participation in a company‑wide annual bonus incentive plan
  • $25 monthly internet stipend
  • Virtual employee groups, clubs, and activities throughout the year
  • Casual dress

Attention Military Spouses

For the last 21 years, we’ve proudly offered 100% remote, W‑2 positions, and we’ve built an environment where career continuity is more than just a buzzword—it’s a reality! Whether you’re stationed at a new base or relocating for a PCS, we offer military spouses the unique opportunity to continue your career without disruption. As an accounting professional, you can take your position with you and keep your career on track no matter where life takes you. We believe in family first and are proud to be a family‑friendly company with an award‑winning culture. In fact, we’ve been nominated by Inc. Magazine for 4 years in a row for our exceptional workplace environment! If you’re looking for a role that values flexibility, career growth, and a supportive work‑life balance, we may just be the perfect fit for you. Join us and experience the benefits of working with a company that truly cares about its people.

How to Become Part of our Future Success

description:

Empresa: CPFL Brasil – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em direito ou economia;
  • Necessária experiência com regulação e comercialização, com foco em geração e mercado livre de energia;
  • Necessário conhecimento aprofundado acerca do arcabouço legal/regulatório do Setor Elétrico;
  • Diferencial conhecimento de estrutura tarifária;
  • Necessário inglês avançado (utilização no dia a dia para reuniões e elaboração de apresentações);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar continuamente alterações legais, infralegais e regulatórias, analisando documentos de ANEEL, MME, CCEE, ONS, EPE e agências estaduais, para identificar riscos e oportunidades para os negócios.
  • Realizar análises técnicas dos impactos regulatórios sobre ativos e produtos, utilizando modelos e dados setoriais, com o objetivo de propor ajustes e mitigadores, além de identificar oportunidades, quando houver.
  • Elaborar e revisar contribuições técnicas para participações públicas, assegurando alinhamento institucional e profundidade técnica dos argumentos.
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de manifestações e recursos administrativos, junto a órgãos reguladores, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a defesa dos interesses da empresa.
  • Analisar preços, encargos setoriais e projeções tarifárias, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para avaliar impactos no Ambiente de Contratação Livre (ACL).
  • Representar tecnicamente a empresa em fóruns, grupos de trabalho e associações setoriais, defendendo posicionamentos estratégicos e promovendo articulação institucional.
  • Analisar e propor ajustes regulatórios aplicáveis aos produtos de comercialização, com foco em competitividade, inovação e conformidade.
  • Interpretar normativos regulatórios aplicáveis a projetos de geração, incluindo temas de conexão e transmissão, para orientar áreas técnicas e jurídicas.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico regulatório do grupo, propondo ações e metas alinhadas à agenda institucional.
  • Apoiar áreas internas com pareceres regulatórios especializados, assegurando segurança jurídica e técnica nas decisões corporativas.
  • Desenvolver materiais executivos para alta liderança, traduzindo temas regulatórios complexos em linguagem acessível e estratégica.
  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e institucional em temas regulatórios.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote‑first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third‑party agency or company without a signed agreement.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations, so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional. Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT). Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades. A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro. Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal. Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas. Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

Department

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

As such, on top of a competitive market bench-marked salary, we offer private healthcare, fertility support and other benefits.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.
  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.
  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.
  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.
  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.
  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.
  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.
  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email.
  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.
  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .
  • Experience in the healthcare or fertility space (nice to have).
  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.
  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success.
  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Compensation Range: $60K - $65K

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Nosso cliente é uma multinacional norte-americana de grande porte, referência global em soluções de tecnologia para gestão de folha de pagamento, recursos humanos e compliance fiscal. Presente em mais de 140 países, atende organizações de diversos portes e segmentos, oferecendo inovação, excelência em serviços e sólida reputação no mercado.

A posição

Profissional responsável por facilitar o planejamento e a execução de Program Increments (PI), liderando todas as fases dos projetos e promovendo a colaboração entre equipes multifuncionais. Atua como elo entre stakeholders e times ágeis, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico, a eficiência operacional e a entrega de resultados de alto valor.

Responsabilidades

  • Facilitar o Planejamento de Incremento de Programa (PI Planning) , colaborando com outros Scrum Masters e o Business Owner. Isso inclui a preparação para o PI Planning, elaboração de planos de PI, coordenação com outras equipes, criação dos objetivos do time para o PI e revisão dos planos finais.
  • Apoiar a Execução das Iterações , facilitando eventos essenciais do ScrumXP, como refinamento do backlog, planejamento da iteração, reuniões diárias (daily stand-ups) e retrospectivas, garantindo alinhamento e progresso contínuo entre os sprints.
  • Liderar todas as fases dos projetos, desde o business case e a iniciação até o encerramento, assegurando que as entregas atendam aos padrões de qualidade, prazos e orçamento.
  • Direcionar as atividades diárias dos projetos dentro de uma organização matricial, assegurando alocação eficiente de recursos e cumprimento dos cronogramas e orçamentos.
  • Promover uma comunicação clara e eficaz entre todas as equipes envolvidas, motivando e orientando-as para atingir objetivos comuns.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as partes interessadas (stakeholders), mantendo uma comunicação contínua ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto e garantindo o gerenciamento adequado das expectativas e a clareza nos resultados.
  • Engajar-se com stakeholders seniores (níveis de Diretoria e Vice-Presidência), fornecendo insights estratégicos e atualizações para apoiar a tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Comunicar de forma clara os objetivos, marcos e progressos do projeto em todos os níveis organizacionais, garantindo transparência e alinhamento.
  • Melhorar o fluxo de trabalho estabelecendo e gerenciando o Kanban Board da equipe, medindo e otimizando a eficiência do fluxo e promovendo a qualidade integrada através dos princípios de Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) .
  • Fomentar um ambiente que incentive dinâmicas de equipe de alto desempenho, melhoria contínua e segurança psicológica. Orientar os membros da equipe, resolver conflitos interpessoais e identificar oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Orientar a equipe a focar na entrega de incrementos de alto valor em cada iteração, alinhando os resultados às prioridades organizacionais.
  • Elevar o desempenho do programa facilitando a colaboração entre equipes, construindo confiança com stakeholders internos e assegurando a conclusão bem-sucedida de cada Incremento de Programa.

Requisitos

  • Mentalidade de crescimento demonstrada, com foco contínuo em aprendizado e melhoria.
  • Certificação Scrum Master (preferencial).
  • Certificação PMP ou equivalente em gerenciamento de projetos (diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada com ferramentas e metodologias estruturadas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Forte experiência em gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de engajar e influenciar em diversos níveis organizacionais.
  • Sólido conhecimento de frameworks e princípios Ágeis, incluindo SAFe e Scrum.
  • Compreensão dos princípios de Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
  • Proficiência no uso de Kanban para planejamento e otimização do fluxo de trabalho.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e liderar equipes multifuncionais, impulsionando resultados, cumprindo marcos e mantendo cronogramas de projeto.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas para apoiar decisões eficazes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de relacionamento, promovendo colaboração entre equipes e stakeholders.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de transmitir informações complexas de forma clara e eficaz.
  • Proficiência em inglês nível C1.
  • Habilidades adicionais em outros idiomas, como francês, alemão ou outro idioma europeu, são consideradas um diferencial.

title: Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)
description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Remote-first, worldwide applicants welcome. Part‑time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full‑time within 12 months based on impact.

Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day‑to‑day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product‑adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion‑ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one‑pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end‑to‑end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self‑serve.

Success Looks Like

  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in‑house).
  • Exceptional taste: refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI with references at hand.
  • Not afraid to be bold; can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus: light motion (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Production of quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

What We Offer

  • Start part‑time freelance; earn full‑time seat in = 12 months through results.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.
  • Work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.

Portfolio & Application

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible). Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets). Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

Apply via email to ******. Share your LinkedIn and portfolio. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters.

Referrals

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing 2x.

title: Senior Compensation Manager (Remote)
description:
Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation

Position Overview

Parsons is seeking a Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation to take end-to-end ownership of our cash incentive programs, stock incentive plans, and overall equity administration—including the Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP). This role also serves as the primary point of contact for incentive compensation audit requests directed to the Compensation Team.

The ideal candidate is a motivated professional with a strong background in administering cash incentive programs, Proxy CD&A compensation and pay versus performance tables. This position requires a self-directed, ambitious individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals. The role offers a mix of recurring responsibilities and initiative-driven projects.

As part of a high-performing team of human resources professionals, you will lead through influence, collaboration, and expertise. Reporting to the Director of Compensation, this role is fully remote/virtual.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incentive Program Ownership
    • Manage the full lifecycle of cash-based incentive programs (STI and deferral) and stock-based incentive programs (LTI and ESPP).
    • Actively lead and mentor a team of two compensation professionals.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive alignment, consistency, and excellence in program delivery.
    • Provide technical expertise to identify, assess, and execute ongoing program and process improvements.
  • Communication & Reporting
    • Develop and implement comprehensive communication plans to ensure leaders are aligned and equipped to engage program participants effectively.
    • Create accurate tracking, reporting, and forecasting solutions for all incentive programs.
    • Conduct regular audits and validations with key stakeholders to ensure program accuracy and compliance.
  • Collaboration & Issue Resolution
    • Partner with finance and payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely forecasting, reporting, and payments.
    • Address and resolve escalated participant questions or issues related to incentive plans promptly and accurately.
  • Technical Oversight
    • Partner with HRIT to translate business and operational needs into system requirements (Workday), oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), and ensure leadership alignment on decisions and recommendations.
  • Additional Contributions
    • Serve as a key contributor to Parsons’ Proxy Compensation & Discussion Analysis compensation and pay versus performance tables, and various Committee / Board materials.
    • Respond to and manage audit requests from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper delegation within the Compensation Team.
    • Lead or provide consultation on incentive compensation-related project initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience
    • 10+ years of related experience in incentive compensation, including some experience managing a team.
    • Industry experience in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure is preferred.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to understand broader concepts and communicate persuasively with HR and business leaders.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Preferred experience with Workday.
  • Interpersonal & Leadership Skills
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.
    • Proven ability to build and leverage relationships across an organization.
    • Strong professionalism, personal accountability, and resilience, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a demanding environment.
    • Demonstrated integrity, objectivity, and the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
  • Certifications
    • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred, or progress toward CCP certification.

Security Clearance Requirement

None

Salary Range

$108,700.00 - $190,200.00

Benefits

We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. O dia a dia

  • Garantir a correta apuração, classificação e registro das operações contábeis, assegurando a conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC), internacionais (IFRS) e do manual de contabilidade do setor elétrico.
  • Garantir tecnicamente o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, assegurando a acuracidade, integridade e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar as demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC, DMPL e Notas Explicativas), atendendo aos requisitos legais, regulatórios e corporativos.
  • Realizar análise crítica das variações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar no atendimento às auditorias internas e externas, garantindo a entrega de documentação técnica, respostas adequadas e o acompanhamento das recomendações.
  • Assegurar o correto reconhecimento contábil de provisões, contingências, ativos imobilizados e ajustes de reclassificação e impairment, com base nas normativas contábeis aplicáveis.
  • Participar da revisão e atualização das políticas contábeis internas, assegurando aderência às melhores práticas do mercado e às exigências regulatórias.
  • Conduzir projetos de melhoria de processos, automação e controles contábeis, visando aumentar a eficiência e a qualidade das informações financeiras.
  • Realizar interface com áreas fiscais, financeiras e operacionais para esclarecimento de dúvidas técnicas, validação de lançamentos contábeis e fornecimento de informações solicitadas.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe contábil, promovendo o desenvolvimento e a capacitação de analistas juniores e plenos.
  • Apoiar na implantação de novos módulos ou atualizações de sistemas ERP relacionados à contabilidade, validando regras e parametrizações.

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead experiente para liderar o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial conversacional. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por guiar o time de engenharia, definir arquiteturas escaláveis e atuar mão na massa no desenvolvimento de serviços Python e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs) para construção de jornadas conversacionais inteligentes.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Liderar o time técnico, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e arquitetura de software.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações e microserviços em Python.
  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de plataformas conversacionais baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Colaborar com times de produto e IA para desenhar jornadas conversacionais complexas, integradas a sistemas externos.

  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e frameworks que melhorem a produtividade e a escalabilidade da plataforma.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead, Líder Técnico ou Arquiteto de Software.
  • Domínio de Python e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (PEP8, tipagem, testes, etc.).
  • Experiência em projetos com LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral ou similares).
  • Vivência na criação de fluxos/jornadas conversacionais com uso de LLMs, LangChain ou frameworks equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (ex: PostgreSQL, Redis).
  • Familiaridade com Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com orquestração de fluxos conversacionais (Rasa, Botpress, ou soluções proprietárias).
  • Possuir conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e modelagem de contexto conversacional.
  • Tiver experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Já tiver trabalhado com arquitetura orientada a eventos e filas de mensagens (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Dominar containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Tiver interesse em IA aplicada à automação de atendimento e agentes inteligentes.

Banco de Talentos - Pessoas com deficiência

Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil.

Nascemos em 2017 com esse compromisso. Desde então, estamos presentes em 39 municípios, com mais de 2,5 mil colaboradores, 6 milhões de clientes e o propósito de atuar da melhor forma para levar saneamento às populações atendidas, ajudando o país a alcançar a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

O saneamento básico no Brasil está no momento de transformação e marcado por novos projetos de expansão. Na Iguá acreditamos que ser diferente é um caminho para ser melhor, essa atitude está no nosso DNA. Valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva, sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade.

Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

Locais de atuação: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Cuiabá, São José do Rio Preto, Mirassol, Andradina, Palestina, Atibaia, Castilho, Piquete, Paranaguá, Arapiraca, Paty do Alferes, Miguel Pereira, Alta Floresta, Pontes e Lacerda, Colíder, Comodoro.

Requisitos e qualificações:

As vagas podem surgir em todas as áreas da empresa. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência, inscreva-se no nosso banco de talentos e, assim que surgir uma oportunidade que combine com o seu perfil, entraremos em contato!

Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.

Desde então, somos uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas com os serviços prestados por nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida por meio de um trabalho de qualidade no fornecimento de água tratada e de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto. Em 2024, fomos eleitos, pelo 8º ano consecutivo, uma ótima empresa para se trabalhar pela consultoria Great Place to Work (GPTW).

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, as pessoas, o meio ambiente, os parceiros e o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado pelo DNA inovador que proporciona um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e de muitos aprendizados, gerando grande impacto na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças estão presentes na empresa para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independente de suas crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos a equidade e respeito e em nossas equipes então venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação! Já somos mais de 2.500 colaboradores e estamos expandindo em um ritmo acelerado e com perspectiva para muito mais!

Você alguma vez já se perguntou sobre seu propósito e qual história quer escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter papel protagonista na sua carreira e impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas? Você pode fazer parte disso!

title: ANALISTA DE LABORATÓRIO JUNIOR (EXPERIENCIA COM GC/MS OU ICP) 100% REMOTO
description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences . É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição do emprego

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema (de acordo com a respectiva linha de negócio), bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analísticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador

We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead Design Operations end-to-end—from brief to delivery. In this role, you’ll run the operating cadence for a global creative team, own the intake and prioritization process, and coordinate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Design. You’ll bring structure to creative work without stifling it: clear briefs, transparent timelines, measurable KPIs, and smooth handoffs. Your work ensures the right projects ship on time, to spec, and with real business impact.

  • Orchestrate day-to-day workflows across the design studio; balance capacity, run weekly planning, and keep the roadmap current.
  • Own the Creative board in Asana: triage requests, clarify briefs, define priorities and due dates, and track status through delivery.
  • Partner with global stakeholders (primarily U.S.) in Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Product to turn business needs into actionable creative plans and timelines.
  • Establish operating cadences—intake, kickoffs, reviews, approvals, retrospectives—and codify SLAs from brief to handoff.
  • Lead vendor operations: NDAs, onboarding, scopes, content coordination, deliverables tracking, and invoice alignment to budget.
  • Define and track KPIs for design projects (throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework rate, stakeholder satisfaction); publish clear reports.
  • Build internal communication formats and knowledge repositories: weekly updates, quarterly reviews, playbooks, and templates.
  • Support formal planning and optimization: annual and quarterly plans, resource modeling, process-improvement experiments, and post-mortems.

Must-Haves

  • Strong process design and change-management skills; can zoom from big picture to detail and back.
  • Ownership mindset: proactive, organized, and unafraid to raise flags early and drive decisions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with U.S.-based teams and join occasional evening calls.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion/Confluence, or similar knowledge-management tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to creative/brand/design workflows; know what a good brief and review cycle looks like.

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).

  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

Ledn offers a comprehensive rewards package, competitive PTO, ownership equity, and the flexibility to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days.

We are an equal‑opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

  • Sólida experiência com Java e seus frameworks principais (Spring Boot, JPA, Lambdas, Functions)
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB)

  • Conhecimento avançado em versionamento, pipelines CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente e apoiar desenvolvedores menos experientes
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Domínio de arquitetura de aplicações distribuídas, arquitetura hexagonal e/ou clean architecture

Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft.

Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you! We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond‑level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. description:
Who we are:

At Mediafly, we help the world’s top revenue teams work smarter and achieve measurable impact. Our platform brings together sales enablement, content, and performance insights so sellers have the coaching, tools, and intelligence they need to succeed. By weaving value selling into every workflow, we empower teams to accelerate deal cycles, boost win rates, and prove ROI.

For you, that means joining a company where innovation meets purpose—where your work helps businesses deliver more meaningful buyer experiences and drives results that truly matter. You’ll be part of a collaborative, growth-focused team that values expertise, creativity, and human connection.

The Director, Product Operations will bring order, consistency, and predictability to how our product organization works. You’ll lead and mentor a small team of Product Managers while building the operational backbone that keeps initiatives moving — ensuring that strategy translates into execution smoothly and efficiently.

This role is perfect for someone who loves clarity, thrives on process, and can bring harmony to a fast-moving cross-functional environment. You’ll be the person who ensures our product teams are aligned, our documentation is standardized, and nothing slips through the cracks.

Responsibilities of a Director, Product Operations:

  • Establish and own frameworks, rituals, and tools that improve consistency, transparency, and accountability across the product organization.
  • Mentor two Sr PMs, helping them prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • Enforce a unified “rulebook” for PRDs, discovery briefs, and other product artifacts. Ensure everything lives in the right place, follows the right format, and tells the right story.
  • Build repeatable systems for how work moves from idea to delivery — including how we plan, track, and review progress.
  • Champion tools like Productboard, Confluence, and Jira to drive cross-functional clarity.
  • Keep the trains running on time. Coordinate dependencies, track timelines, and help teams anticipate and unblock risks before they slow momentum.
  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, and GTM to make sure everyone understands priorities, status, and the “why” behind decisions.

We would love to meet you if you have:

  • 8+ years in product or program management, with at least 2 years leading teams.
  • Previous experience working in a SaaS company, ideally in a product operations or product management function.
  • Deep experience building scalable processes for product planning, documentation, and release management.
  • A knack for simplifying complexity and creating structure without bureaucracy.
  • Strong communication skills — able to align executives and empower ICs alike.
  • Familiarity with tools like Productboard, Jira, and Confluence, and the judgment to know when a process helps (and when it hinders).

Success Looks Like:

  • Every product initiative has a clear owner, definition of success, and consistent documentation.
  • The team knows what’s next, what’s blocked, and where to find information — always.
  • Leadership can trust that roadmaps, PRDs, and metrics are complete, standardized, and up to date.
  • Product Managers and cross-functional partners feel empowered, supported, and aligned.

US Base Salary: $155,000 - $175,000

Canada Base Salary: CA$180,000 - CA$200,000

Location and Work Setup:

This is a 100% remote position with a collaborative team that values flexibility and trust. We use modern communication and collaboration tools to stay connected and productive across time zones.
